evaluations.title: A hook must belong to the same story
evaluations.scenario: A strong reaction from one participant is followed by a different participant's unrelated explanation.
evaluations.expected_reason: Reject because the opening does not have setup, continuity, and a payoff in the same source arc.

evaluations.title: Caption timing must follow speech
evaluations.scenario: A proposed cut begins inside a spoken word and would remove the leading phoneme.
evaluations.expected_reason: Reject and move the boundary to a complete forced-word interval.

evaluations.title: Motion needs a communication purpose
evaluations.scenario: A decorative whoosh or chart is proposed without a source-grounded event or value.
evaluations.expected_reason: Omit the layer because it does not clarify a source fact or narrative beat.

evaluations.title: Challenge reveal needs complete evidence
evaluations.scenario: The source contains a question, a participant attempt, and a visible result or reaction.
evaluations.expected_reason: Select the challenge/question reveal pattern because the source contains setup, attempt, and resolution.

evaluations.title: Reference popularity is not causal proof
evaluations.scenario: A reference clip is described as viral but has no verified views, retention, or posting data.
evaluations.expected_reason: Keep craft observations but label performance evidence unavailable.

guidance_cards.title: Flash-forward hooks must resolve in the same arc
guidance_cards.intent: Create curiosity with a strong moment while preserving a coherent setup, escalation, and payoff.
triggers: source contains a complete question or reaction arc
a later moment is stronger than the natural opening
prerequisites: source spans for hook, setup, and payoff are present
each occurrence has its own speech-safe caption timing
steps: Identify the strongest source-grounded phrase or reaction.
Verify that the body supplies the context for that moment.
Place the complete arc in output order and declare any intentional repeat.
Reject the treatment when the hook and body use unrelated participants or claims.
coordination: preserve canonical TimeMap order for each output occurrence
keep faces, app proof, and captions visible
use a transition only when the reviewed arc supports it
avoid_when: the body changes subject or meaning
the source has no defensible payoff
limitations: This is an editorial heuristic, not a retention guarantee.
A reference clip without outcome data cannot prove performance.

guidance_cards.title: Cuts and captions follow complete spoken words
guidance_cards.intent: Keep picture, speech, and captions synchronized at every cut and cue boundary.
triggers: a candidate uses a jump cut
a caption or alignment interval changes
prerequisites: the current TimeMap digest is available
steps: Move cut boundaries outside spoken words.
Remap captions and audio through the current TimeMap.
Inspect first, interior, and final cue edges in the encoded MP4.
coordination: Arabic uses shaped runs and RTL layout
changed TimeMap invalidates caption and render evidence
avoid_when: alignment is approximate for a final Hero render
a cut would split a word or duplicate a speech interval
limitations: Alignment evidence does not identify an active speaker.
OCR is supplementary and cannot replace alignment evidence.

guidance_cards.title: Motion must clarify a source-grounded event
guidance_cards.intent: Choose motion by communication purpose instead of filling every interval with effects.
triggers: a source fact needs a diagram or reveal
prerequisites: the source evidence names the fact or beat
the selected component is allowlisted and deterministic
steps: Name the MotionPurpose and source evidence.
Select an approved recipe compatible with the locale and safe region.
Use the smallest effect that clarifies the beat.
Render a pilot and remove the layer if it competes with speech or faces.
coordination: never cover a required caption or face
never invent numeric diagrams or labels
sound accents may overlap speech only with an explicit mix decision
avoid_when: the event has no source evidence
the selected component requires a missing dependency
limitations: Motion guidance does not prove viewer retention.
Ready-made components still require license and deterministic-runtime checks.

guidance_cards.title: Separate craft observations from performance claims
guidance_cards.intent: Use reference videos to learn observable craft without inventing causal retention or reach claims.
triggers: an operator calls a reference viral
a style card is built from supplied clips
prerequisites: reference permission and source hash are recorded
outcomes are kept separate from visual/audio observations
steps: Record what is visibly or audibly observed.
Record unknowns such as missing analytics or mixed audio stems.
Use verified outcomes only when analytics evidence supplies them.
Scope the resulting style card to its evidence and source domain.
coordination: reference analysis may guide Codex but cannot approve a render
unsupported claims remain excluded from captions and graphics
avoid_when: a metric is inferred from appearance or popularity alone
limitations: A craft pattern is not a universal platform rule.
One reference cannot establish a causal performance result.

narrative_patterns.name: Flash-forward payoff with complete arc
narrative_patterns.hook_shape: Strong complete phrase, answer, mistake, or reaction from the same story.
narrative_patterns.body_shape: Return to the setup, preserve the speaker and participant continuity, and show the attempt.
narrative_patterns.payoff_shape: Reach the original moment and finish on the source's result or reaction.
continuity_rules: hook and body must belong to one coherent source arc
each output occurrence retains its own speech and caption evidence
repetition_rules: repeat the hook at most once and mark it as intentional
reject_when: the hook and body use unrelated participants
the result is absent or promised without evidence

style_cards.name: Tarteel challenge readable
pacing_rules: open on a complete question, reaction, or challenge
use purposeful cuts between setup, attempt, and result
keep a readable final result hold
audio_rules: music remains prohibited unless policy changes
ending_rules: end on the demonstrated result or reaction
CTA cannot cover faces, app proof, or captions
limitations: reference clips have no verified retention or view data
Arabic and Quran text retain their separate evidence gates
